In the first survey, given a sample, we ask the user to choose the best perceived emotion from a set of four, namely, 'Happy', 'Sad', 'Angry' and 'Fear'. In the second survey we evaluate the efficacy of the models to bring about finer control over emotion. We generate two samples with same broader emotion category but with two levels of intensity. The subject now has to identify the sample with higher intensity.
